description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different DPR configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S.)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A black solid line, labeled “DPR w/o query”, begins at approximately 34.8 when S=1 and increases to approximately 35.2 when S=10. A yellow solid line, labeled “DPR w/ gold”, begins at approximately 35.3 when S=1 and increases to approximately 35.6 when S=10. A green solid line, labeled “DPR w/ top-1”, begins at approximately 33.3 when S=1 and increases to approximately 36.1 when S=10. A purple dashed line, labeled “DPR w/ bottom-1”, begins at approximately 34.9 when S=1 and decreases to approximately 34.7 when S=10. A blue dashed line, labeled “DPR w/ random”, begins at approximately 35.1 when S=1 and remains relatively constant at approximately 35.1 when S=10. A red dashed line, labeled “DPR w/ curriculum”, begins at approximately 35.5 when S=1 and remains relatively constant at approximately 35.5 when S=10.
